assumptions: The requirement does not define an explicit requirement ID; REQ-108 (from the document heading) is used as the requirement_reference.
"Above $1,000,000" is assumed to mean strictly greater than; an order of exactly $1,000,000 is assumed not to require dual-authorization.
The requirement does not state the consequence of insufficient margin balance; it is assumed the clearing engine rejects or holds the trade and blocks settlement.
The requirement does not state the consequence of missing or partial dual-authorization; it is assumed the order is blocked from routing rather than auto-approved or auto-escalated.
The requirement does not specify the numeric value of the Tier-2 volatility threshold; scenarios treat it as a configurable trigger point to be simulated rather than a fixed number.
The requirement does not state what happens when a settlement exceeds the 250ms target; it is assumed this is logged/flagged as a breach rather than silently accepted or automatically retried.
The requirement does not enumerate required order fields or supported currency pairs; validation scenarios assume standard fields (amount, currency pair, counterparty identifier) are mandatory.
No instruction-like or injected content was found in the source requirement or design; none was excluded.

SC-15 (missing required field) and SC-17 (multiple currency pairs) and SC-18 (differing counterparty risk profiles) each yield multiple distinct test cases because the design specifies concrete distinct data variations for those scenarios.

test_cases.title: Standard cross-currency trade below threshold settles within SLA
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the trade
Market volatility is within normal (sub Tier-2) conditions
Two valid counterparties are configured for the trade
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order for $500,000 USD equivalent between two valid counterparties
Observe the clearing engine validate margin balance and lock in the trade
Measure the elapsed time for settlement completion
test_cases.expected_result: The settlement completes within 250ms, the order does not require dual-authorization, and pacs.008 confirmation messages are emitted to both counterparties.

test_cases.title: High-value order above $1,000,000 settles after dual-authorization approval
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance for the trade
Two designated dual-authorization approvers are available
Market volatility is within normal conditions
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order for $2,500,000 USD
Have the first designated approver approve the order
Have the second designated approver approve the order
Observe the order route to the clearing engine and complete settlement
test_cases.expected_result: The order is held pending both approvals, then routes to the clearing engine only after both approvals are recorded, settles successfully, and pacs.008 confirmations are sent to both counterparties.

test_cases.title: Bilateral counterparty risk is verified for both parties before settlement
preconditions: Two counterparties with valid, current risk profiles are configured
Trading account has sufficient margin balance
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order between Counterparty A and Counterparty B
Observe the clearing engine perform a bilateral counterparty risk check for both parties prior to lock-in
test_cases.expected_result: The system records a completed bilateral risk verification for both Counterparty A and Counterparty B before the trade is locked in, and settlement proceeds only after both checks pass.

test_cases.title: Order above $1,000,000 without dual-authorization is blocked from routing
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
No dual-authorization approvals have been obtained for the order
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order for $1,500,000 USD
Do not obtain any dual-authorization approvals
Attempt to allow the order to proceed to routing
test_cases.expected_result: The order is blocked from routing to the clearing engine, no settlement occurs, and no pacs.008 confirmation messages are emitted.

test_cases.title: Trade with insufficient margin balance is prevented from lock-in
preconditions: Trading account margin balance is configured to be less than the required amount for the submitted trade
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order for $300,000 USD against an account with insufficient margin balance
Observe the clearing engine's margin validation step prior to lock-in
test_cases.expected_result: The clearing engine rejects or holds the trade before lock-in, no settlement occurs, and no pacs.008 confirmation messages are emitted.

test_cases.title: One of two dual-authorization approvers rejects a high-value order
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
Two designated dual-authorization approvers are available for the order
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order for $1,200,000 USD
Have the first designated approver approve the order
Have the second designated approver reject the order
test_cases.expected_result: The order is not routed to the clearing engine, remains in an unrouted/rejected state, and no settlement or pacs.008 confirmation occurs.

test_cases.title: Direct settlement attempt is rejected when Tier-2 circuit breaker is already active
preconditions: Market volatility monitor reports volatility already exceeding the Tier-2 circuit-breaker threshold
Trading account has sufficient margin balance
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order for $400,000 USD while the Tier-2 circuit breaker is active
Attempt to force an immediate settlement completion for the order
test_cases.expected_result: The system rejects the immediate settlement attempt and instead transitions the order to a queued settlement state; no pacs.008 confirmation is emitted until the order later settles.

test_cases.title: Order of exactly $1,000,000 does not require dual-authorization
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
Market volatility is within normal conditions
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order for exactly $1,000,000.00 USD
Observe whether the system requires dual-authorization before routing
test_cases.expected_result: The order is routed to the clearing engine and settles without requiring dual-authorization, confirming the threshold is strictly greater-than $1,000,000.

test_cases.title: Order of $1,000,000.01 requires dual-authorization
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
Market volatility is within normal conditions
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order for $1,000,000.01 USD
Observe whether the system requires dual-authorization before routing
test_cases.expected_result: The order is held pending dual-authorization and is not routed to the clearing engine until both approvals are obtained.

test_cases.title: Order of $999,999.99 does not require dual-authorization
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
Market volatility is within normal conditions
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order for $999,999.99 USD
Observe whether the system requires dual-authorization before routing
test_cases.expected_result: The order routes directly to the clearing engine and settles without requiring dual-authorization.

test_cases.title: Settlement completing at exactly 250ms is treated as compliant
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
Market volatility is within normal conditions
Settlement timing can be simulated or measured precisely
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order under normal market conditions
Simulate or measure the settlement completing at exactly 250ms
test_cases.expected_result: The settlement at exactly 250ms is treated as compliant with the SLA and is not flagged as a performance breach.

test_cases.title: Settlement exceeding 250ms under normal conditions is flagged as a performance breach
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
Market volatility is within normal conditions
Settlement timing can be simulated or measured precisely
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order under normal market conditions
Simulate or measure the settlement taking 251ms or longer to complete
test_cases.expected_result: The settlement is flagged/logged as a performance SLA breach, even though the trade itself still completes.

test_cases.title: Volatility reaching exactly the Tier-2 threshold transitions the order to queued state
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
Market volatility can be simulated at the exact Tier-2 circuit-breaker threshold value
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order while simulating market volatility rising to exactly the Tier-2 threshold
Observe the settlement state assigned to the order
test_cases.expected_result: The order automatically transitions to a queued settlement state rather than completing immediately.

test_cases.title: Order with malformed or unsupported currency pair is rejected before settlement processing
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order with currency pair field set to an unsupported value 'XYZ/QQQ'
Observe the system's validation response prior to settlement processing
test_cases.expected_result: The order is rejected with a validation error identifying the unsupported/malformed currency pair, and no settlement processing or pacs.008 confirmation occurs.

test_cases.title: Order missing the trade amount field is rejected with a validation error
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order with the trade amount field omitted
Observe the system's validation response
test_cases.expected_result: The order submission is rejected with a validation error indicating the trade amount is required, and no settlement occurs.

test_cases.title: Order missing the currency pair field is rejected with a validation error
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order with the currency pair field omitted
Observe the system's validation response
test_cases.expected_result: The order submission is rejected with a validation error indicating the currency pair is required, and no settlement occurs.

test_cases.title: Order missing the counterparty identifier field is rejected with a validation error
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order with the counterparty identifier field omitted
Observe the system's validation response
test_cases.expected_result: The order submission is rejected with a validation error indicating the counterparty identifier is required, and no settlement occurs.

test_cases.title: Completed settlement emits a schema-valid ISO 20022 pacs.008 confirmation message
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
Market volatility is within normal conditions
steps: Submit and complete a standard cross-currency trade settlement
Capture the pacs.008 confirmation messages emitted to both counterparties
Validate the captured messages against the ISO 20022 pacs.008 schema and mandatory field list
test_cases.expected_result: Both emitted pacs.008 messages are schema-valid and contain all ISO 20022 mandatory fields, with no missing or malformed elements.

test_cases.title: Settlement behaves consistently for a USD/EUR currency pair
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
Market volatility is within normal conditions
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order using the USD/EUR currency pair
Observe settlement completion and confirmation messaging
test_cases.expected_result: The settlement completes within 250ms and pacs.008 confirmations are correctly emitted for the USD/EUR pair.

test_cases.title: Settlement behaves consistently for a USD/JPY currency pair
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
Market volatility is within normal conditions
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order using the USD/JPY currency pair
Observe settlement completion and confirmation messaging
test_cases.expected_result: The settlement completes within 250ms and pacs.008 confirmations are correctly emitted for the USD/JPY pair.

test_cases.title: Settlement behaves consistently for a GBP/CHF currency pair
preconditions: Trading account has sufficient margin balance
Market volatility is within normal conditions
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order using the GBP/CHF currency pair
Observe settlement completion and confirmation messaging
test_cases.expected_result: The settlement completes within 250ms and pacs.008 confirmations are correctly emitted for the GBP/CHF pair.

test_cases.title: Bilateral risk verification behaves correctly for a high-risk-rated counterparty
preconditions: One counterparty in the trade has a high-risk rating configured
Trading account has sufficient margin balance
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order involving the high-risk-rated counterparty
Observe the bilateral counterparty risk verification outcome
test_cases.expected_result: The risk verification step correctly evaluates the high-risk-rated counterparty and applies the appropriate outcome (proceed, hold, or additional check) consistent with the platform's risk rules.

test_cases.title: Bilateral risk verification behaves correctly for a low-risk-rated counterparty
preconditions: Both counterparties in the trade have a low-risk rating configured
Trading account has sufficient margin balance
steps: Submit a cross-currency trade order involving two low-risk-rated counterparties
Observe the bilateral counterparty risk verification outcome
test_cases.expected_result: The risk verification step passes for both low-risk-rated counterparties and the trade proceeds to settlement without additional holds.

test_cases.title: High volume of concurrent settlements each complete within SLA with correct confirmations
preconditions: Trading accounts involved have sufficient margin balance
Market volatility is within normal conditions
The system is configured to accept a high volume of concurrent orders
steps: Submit a large batch of concurrent cross-currency trade settlement requests under normal market conditions
Measure the settlement completion time for each request
Verify pacs.008 confirmation messages are emitted for each completed settlement
test_cases.expected_result: Every concurrent settlement completes within 250ms and each receives a correct, correctly addressed pacs.008 confirmation message with no cross-order mixing or loss.

test_cases.title: Orders route to the correct settlement path as market volatility fluctuates across a sequence
preconditions: Trading accounts involved have sufficient margin balance
Market volatility can be simulated to fluctuate between normal and Tier-2 threshold states
steps: Submit a sequence of cross-currency trade orders while simulating market volatility alternating between normal and Tier-2-exceeding states
Observe the settlement path assigned to each order in the sequence
test_cases.expected_result: Each order in the sequence is routed to the correct settlement path: immediate completion when volatility is normal, and queued settlement state when volatility exceeds the Tier-2 threshold at submission time.
